verdict.rationale: BAMF does publish statistics: a monthly asylum-intake figure (5,276 new entries in September) and an annual monitoring report on education and labour migration. That suggests statistical publications exist. However, nothing shows these come as bulk, machine-readable downloads or dataset extracts rather than web text or reports. missing for 10: evidence of downloadable datasets or extracts (CSV/XLSX/open-data portal), machine-readable asylum or case statistics series, documentation of formats and update cadence, independent corroboration.
